title: arabic-normalize request (input contract)
description: One normalisation request: a single text or up to 10,000 texts, plus a built-in policy id or an inline policy object. Each text must be valid UTF-8 (no lone surrogates) and at most 10 MiB (10,485,760 bytes) when encoded as UTF-8; the byte cap is enforced by the library because JSON Schema cannot count UTF-8 bytes. Inline policies follow src/arabic_normalize/policies/schema.json; no member may start with '$' and nothing is ever fetched. JSONL input is one JSON object per line with a string field (default 'text').
